outputs.explanation: Panel is a representative spatial-clustering image of a single lung section with no quantification or statistics; no replicate reporting is required.
Panel shows a representative H&E image and manual annotation of the same single section; no quantitative/replicated data is presented.
Panel shows representative spatial expression maps overlaid on the H&E image from a single section, without quantification or statistical comparison across replicates.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3) with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and P values
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: Panel reports NES, FDR and p-values from GSEA comparing tumor regions within a single spatial transcriptomics section, but does not state the number or type of biological/technical replicates (e.g., number of sections, animals, or spots per group) underlying the comparison; only the permutation method for the statistical test is given.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: Bar graph presents log2 fold-change values with p-values from DEG analysis comparing Tmprss11b-high versus low LUSC spatial transcriptomics data, but the legend does not report the number of replicates (e.g., spots, sections, or animals) compared, nor explicitly names the replicate type/unit of analysis.
